Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the six-month internship in Strategic Communications at FTI Consulting Brussels. I am a digital marketer with a technical background, and my daily work overlaps more with your internship than it might look: tracking how search and AI systems shift, reading dense material closely, and turning it into short, clear reports for clients.

At Episto I handle research, SEO content and reporting for client sites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console to follow what changes and why. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I worked on SharePoint platforms for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. I also build and maintain a pharmacists' association site, which keeps me close to healthcare-sector communication in Turkish and English.

My English is fluent, Turkish is native, and I am based in Belgium, within commuting distance of Brussels. I would welcome the chance to bring that research and writing to your team.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the six-month internship in Strategic Communications at FTI Consulting Brussels. I came into communications from a technical route — websites, search, content — and that is part of why this role appeals to me. The questions your team works on, regulation, reputation and how a policy decision lands with the public, are decided in the same space where I already work: where search engines, AI systems and public information meet.

Since 2024 I have worked on client projects across web, content and search. At Knowledge Experts I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, and built client websites from structure through content. At Episto I handle keyword research and SEO content for client sites and report on performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console. A large part of that work is what your posting describes: monitoring how things change, reading dense material carefully, and writing it up so someone else can act on it quickly. I also maintain a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profile pages, which keeps me in regular contact with healthcare-sector communication — one of the sectors your Brussels team covers.

Earlier, at ViviDoctor in Belgium, I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application, so I have worked inside a regulated sector as well as around it.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, within commuting distance of Brussels, and available to travel. My English is fluent, Turkish is native and my Dutch is improving. I would like to learn from your team and to be genuinely useful early on: on the research, on the drafting and on the day-to-day running of client accounts.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- Research, analysis and reporting: keyword research, SEO content and performance reporting for client sites, tracked in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console
- Client project work: supported SharePoint digital workplace builds for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff) at Knowledge Experts; built client websites from structure to content
- Stakeholder-facing content: builds and maintains majistraleczacilari.org.tr, a pharmacists' association site with a consistent layout for ~600 member profiles — healthcare-sector communication in Turkish and English
- Regulated-sector exposure: front-end development for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, Belgium (2018-2019)
- Languages and location: English fluent, Turkish native, Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+); based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, available to travel — with daily use of LLMs for research, content and audits
